The ratio of populations follows Boltzmann:

n1/n2 = (g1/g2) exp(ΔE/kT)

The ratio (no spots)/(with spots):

R = exp(ΔE/k · (1/T_spots - 1/T_nospots))

ΔE = hc/λ, with λ = 1448 Å.

ΔE/k = hc/(λk) = (6.626e-34 × 3e8)/(1448e-10 × 1.38e-23)
= (1.988e-25)/(1.998e-30)
= 9.95e4 K

So ΔE/k ≈ 99500 K.

Temperatures: no spots = 6000 K, with spots = 5500 K.

1/5500 - 1/6000 = (6000-5500)/(5500×6000) = 500/33,000,000 = 1.515e-5

R = exp(99500 × 1.515e-5) = exp(1.507) = 4.51

Answer: D
